scripts.build:messenger: npm run version:sync && VITE_SYNCROVA_STANDALONE_MESSENGER=1 node --max-old-space-size=4096 ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build
scripts.cap:sync: npm run version:sync && npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:messenger: npm run build:messenger && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk:linux: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:release:linux: npm run android:sdk:check:linux && npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && node ../scripts/publish-android-release.cjs
scripts.android:apk:messenger:release:linux: npm run android:sdk:check:linux && npm run cap:sync:messenger && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease -PsyncrovaMessenger=true && node ../scripts/publish-android-release.cjs --messenger
scripts.android:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && set "JAVA_HOME=C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr" && set "PATH=C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr\bin;%PATH%" && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && set "JAVA_HOME=C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr" && set "PATH=C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr\bin;%PATH%" && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
